proposals.label: obsidian_fast_lookup_boundary

visibilityAssessment.missingInformation: The Cursor page passage found with the term 'sublinear' was visible to the user during a short browser visit but no corresponding READ entered the packed context before example 123.
visibilityAssessment.evidence: Examples 121 and 122 retain the URL and Find actions; example 123's exact packed history contains neither the relevant page passage nor an equivalent READ.

partitions.notes: The Obsidian phrase ends mid-clause before the lookup and is not a closed substantive outcome.
The exact URL is a navigation command, not the substantive thought target.
The in-page Find query remains causal action history but receives no substantive-content loss.
The insight is substantive but cannot receive loss because its supporting page passage is missing from the model-facing input.

proposals.notes: This sequence is not one giant episode: new external information closes the initial opportunity, but the later opportunity is under-conditioned in the old capture.

proposals.label: obsidian_gtm_composition
proposals.notes: The intervening READ is an exact repeat of content already present twice in the episode-onset model input. Continuous field-state replay and stable application/document/role establish one logical editable despite the changed AX element hash. The AX cursor still disagrees with the net insertion offset, so that disagreement remains explicit even though the continuous insertion transition supports this shadow merge proposal.

proposals.label: code_independent_commands
proposals.notes: Each terminal command is a separate action even when commands occur within seconds of one another.
